canonical_source: City of Toronto One Address Repository / Address Points

fields.ADDRESS_ID: Related City address identifier retained for joins/provenance.
fields.ADDRESS_POINT_ID_LINK: City-provided linked Address Point identifier; relationship retained without inventing parent/ownership semantics.
fields.ADDRESS_ID_LINK: City-provided linked Address identifier; relationship retained without inventing parent/ownership semantics.
fields.CENTRELINE_ID: Street centreline identifier retained as provenance/context.

legacy_mapping: Building-permit GEO_ID values were directly checked against the current Address Points source and correspond to ADDRESS_POINT_ID where the historical ID remains represented. Missing historical values are not silently treated as current IDs; exact civic address resolution is recorded separately.
canonical_address_rule: Only the civic-address segment before the first comma is canonicalized; municipality names are not stripped from inside valid street names.
known_fix: Pre-1.1 logic could truncate Royal York Rd, York Rd and New Toronto St. Final 1.1 cleanup repairs existing canonical addresses and regenerates joins.
